patterns.name: Secret scanner noise collapse
patterns.signal: Secret findings are dominated by duplicates, self-reference, logs, placeholders, or env substitutions.
patterns.root_cause: The scanner confuses review artifacts and inert examples with live credential material.
patterns.intervention: Deduplicate roots, skip known log/self-scan paths, suppress placeholders and env substitutions, then rerun audit.
patterns.guard: Secret findings must be zero or human-triaged before launch-oriented work proceeds.
patterns.next_action: Run omni audit and inspect secret_findings.json.

patterns.name: Dev-default credential fallback
patterns.signal: Runtime code contains credential-bearing fallback URLs or auth defaults.
patterns.root_cause: Local bootstrap convenience leaked into runtime configuration paths.
patterns.intervention: Require operator-supplied env vars or explicit arguments; degrade only to non-network local persistence.
patterns.guard: Credential-bearing defaults must not be committed in runtime, scripts, or config.
patterns.next_action: Scan for credential-bearing URLs and auth defaults before merge.

patterns.name: YAML inline-comment config drift
patterns.signal: Audit config values parse as strings when inline comments follow scalar values.
patterns.root_cause: Tiny YAML loader did not strip comments outside quoted strings.
patterns.intervention: Strip inline comments before scalar coercion and add parser regression tests.
patterns.guard: Audit config must load through the default CLI path before generated reports are trusted.
patterns.next_action: Run default no-network audit smoke test.

patterns.name: Truth-integrity public claim debt
patterns.signal: PROHIBITED, NEEDS_REWRITE, or PROOF_REQUIRED claims remain after P0 secret cleanup.
patterns.root_cause: Marketing and doctrine text can move faster than receipt-backed evidence.
patterns.intervention: Remove, soften, or receipt-link exact public claims before launch or paid distribution.
patterns.guard: Paid/public launch is blocked while prohibited or unreceipted exact claims remain.
patterns.next_action: Shift priority to public claim discipline when secrets are zero.

patterns.name: Supply-chain reproducibility gap
patterns.signal: Cargo.lock or SBOM artifacts are missing for releasable workspaces.
patterns.root_cause: Build reproducibility and attestation are not yet first-class release gates.
patterns.intervention: Add lockfiles, SBOM generation, and dependency advisory/license policy.
patterns.guard: Release promotion requires lockfile and SBOM evidence.
patterns.next_action: Generate reproducibility artifacts after truth-integrity blockers close.

patterns.name: Runtime panic and command-execution surface
patterns.signal: Hot-path unwrap, panic, shell=True, broad except, or dynamic execution findings remain.
patterns.root_cause: Prototype acceleration leaves implicit failure behavior in production-adjacent paths.
patterns.intervention: Classify by hot path, replace fail-open behavior with typed errors, and add regression tests.
patterns.guard: Promotion requires hot-path panic and command execution review.
patterns.next_action: Triage code_risks.json by rule and subsystem.
